subject: Music Production
title: Affordable Gear Opens Doors
description: A quick, practical guide to Affordable Gear Opens Doors.

hook.text: By the 2000s, a decent audio interface and microphone cost less than a single hour of studio time.

buildup.text: Software companies released powerful digital audio workstations for under two hundred dollars.

discovery.text: For the first time, anyone with a laptop could produce music rivaling professional studios.

twist.text: Expensive studios that once controlled recording access suddenly struggled to fill bookings.

climax.text: A global wave of independent artists emerged, producing hit records from bedrooms and basements.

punchline.text: Cheap gear let anyone become a music producer.

quiz.question: What effect did affordable gear have on professional studios?
options: Studios struggled as artists recorded at home
